meta.name: communication
meta.description: Communication standards for explaining technical concepts to different audiences. Use when presenting results, writing explanations, or preparing presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把技术概念讲到不同听众都能懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常要向非技术的人讲清技术要点。
copy.tagline_en: Explain technical concepts clearly to any audience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make technical topics understandable to non-experts.

howto.what: Claude 会按听众调整技术解释:给非技术人员先讲结论、用类比;给同行讲方法、关键数字与权衡;给专家讲方法论细节。解释复杂概念时按「是什么、怎么做、为什么」三句话组织;做演示时一页一个观点、标题即结论;写作使用主动语态和短句。
howto.when: 当你要汇报结果、写技术解释或准备演示时触发。这些场合下,Claude 会按本技能的标准来组织讲解与文稿。

say.text: 把这段风险模型结果讲给不懂技术的领导听,先给结论。
用三句话向技术同事解释 Monte Carlo 模拟。
say.note: Claude 会套用「是什么、怎么做、为什么」三句框架。

say.text: 帮我检查这页 PPT:一页一个观点,标题即结论。
say.note: Claude 会按幻灯片结构规范逐条核对。

howto.what_en: Claude adapts to audience: conclusion-first with analogies for non-tech listeners; method/data/trade-offs for peers; nuance for experts. Uses What/How/Why; one idea per slide with title as conclusion; active short sentences.
howto.when_en: Triggers when presenting results, writing explanations, or preparing presentations. Claude then follows these communication standards to structure explanations and documents.

say_en.text: Explain this risk result to a non-technical boss; lead with the conclusion.
say_en.note: Formats it per the Executive audience level.

say_en.text: Explain Monte Carlo simulation to a technical peer in three sentences.
say_en.note: Applies the What / How / Why three-sentence rule.

say_en.text: Check my slide: one idea per slide, title states the conclusion.
say_en.note: Reviews against the slide structure tips.
